title: Renovation deliverable template
description: The sheet list of a real, delivered document set, observed in an album a named practitioner published - plus, per sheet, what this repo's own tooling would need in order to produce the equivalent. The target that the wiki -> layout -> CAD pipeline is aiming at.

tier.description: Product tier as the practitioner markets it. planning_project deliberately omits visualisation and schedules.

excluded_from_scope.description: What this tier deliberately leaves out, in the practitioner's own terms - the difference between tiers is mostly this list.

number.description: Sheet number as printed, e.g. '4' or '14.2'.

purpose.description: What a builder actually uses this sheet for.

consumes.description: What data the sheet needs - e.g. 'measured plan', 'furniture layout', 'circuit assignment'.

producible_from.description: Honest statement of whether this repo could generate the sheet today from data it holds.

our_tooling.description: Repo-relative scripts that would generate or contribute to it.

gap.description: What is missing before we could produce this sheet.
